name: @travel/load-tests
description: Load and spike test profiles with latency gates for the travel platform (WO-098).

scripts.report:sustained: tsx reporting/generate-report.ts --profile sustained-peak --k6-json results/sustained-peak.json --cw-json results/sustained-peak-cw.json --out-json results/sustained-peak-report.json --out-md results/sustained-peak-report.md
scripts.report:spike: tsx reporting/generate-report.ts --profile spike-ramp --k6-json results/spike-ramp.json --cw-json results/spike-ramp-cw.json --out-json results/spike-ramp-report.json --out-md results/spike-ramp-report.md
scripts.gate:speedscale: k6 run profiles/sustained-peak.ts -e LOAD_ENV=$LOAD_ENV --out json=results/gate-run.json && tsx reporting/generate-report.ts --profile sustained-peak --k6-json results/gate-run.json --cw-json results/gate-cw.json --out-json results/gate-report.json --out-md results/gate-report.md
